## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] Bug fix: an example in `examples/` or a test fails without the fix
- [ ] Language change: discussed in an issue first, and the spec, the constructs table, the grammar, the parser, the printer, examples and `CHANGELOG.md` are all updated (see CONTRIBUTING.md, "Changing the language")
- [ ] `npm run generate` was run and `grammar/` is committed, if the grammar or the tables changed
- [ ] I agree my code is released under MIT and my spec changes under CC BY 4.0
